text:
maya_eng: Quick heads up - Tom posted updated lead times for the H100 tranche. Sea ~45d, air ~6d. They're pushing fewer air slots and offered a mixed plan: partial air expedite + vendor credit for DOAs + loaner pool. Need decision on air top-up vs credit for EU edge pools.

 tom_vendor: From our side: air possible for up to 20 units at +$10k/unit, or loaner pool up to 30 units at $200/day/unit until swapped. DOA coverage: 30% credit on affected units + depot repair SLA (7 business days). We can split AWBs by region.

 raj_procure: Can you break down costs? air 10 vs air 20 to EU delta, plus any brokerage/insurance add-ons? Also clarify credit mechanics (timing & invoice offset).

 tom_vendor: Air 10 -> +$100k. Air 20 -> +$200k. Brokerage typically billed separately; we can waive brokerage if PO amendment signed today. Credit flow: vendor issues credit memo within 10 business days after photo + serial evidence; applied to next invoice. Cash refunds take ~30 days and need escalation.

 elaine_ops: Ops question: Depot capacity in FRA / AMS for receiving and serial reconciliation? If we partial-air, can swaps be performed within 48h of arrival? We need vendor to pre-generate RMA labels and agree manifest format. Also confirm HS code for air vs sea.

 ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-VEND-4521 - "EU air top-up + RMA label flow" assigned to elaine_ops. https://redwood.example/tickets/INF-VEND-4521

 maya_eng: Preference: minimize cash. Prefer credit + loaners for bulk, but approve air for critical EU pools up to 10 units. If vendor waives brokerage and provides 48h serial list turnaround, we go air 10 + credit for rest.

 tom_vendor: We can waive brokerage for this batch if you sign the PO amendment today. RMA labels: we will pre-generate. Need serial CSV within 48h of pickup to bind AWBs. Sample manifest:

 ```
 serial,model,site,preferred_depot,claimed_issue
 H100-ABC123,H100,fra-edge-01,FRA-DEPOT-3,doa
 H100-ABC124,H100,fra-edge-02,FRA-DEPOT-3,doa
 ```

 raj_procure: OK locking plan: air 10 -> vendor to send PO amendment + waiver. Rest: credit + loaner pool until replacements ship. Please confirm loaner pickup/drop policy and daily cap.

 elaine_ops: Ops will prepare depot slots FRA-DEPOT-3 and AMS-POOL-1 and pre-authorize swap labels. We'll require photo evidence on receipt and a short QC checklist.

 tom_vendor: Will send PO amendment + waiver PDF by EOD. AWB splits: EU-air (10 units) AWB: EU-AT-75819; rest sea LCL AWB: SEA-LCL-99822. We'll upload photos to the RMA portal and provide tracking. Insurance value will be on AWB.

 maya_eng: :thumbsup: Also include carrier contact and insurance value in the amendment. Ops - once INF-VEND-4521 has depot manifest + serial CSV, tag me and raj.

 ops-bot: Updated INF-VEND-4521: depot slots reserved FRA-DEPOT-3 (up to 12 swaps) and AMS-POOL-1 (loaners up to 30). ETA window for air arrival approx 1761420000 - 1761423600.

 raj_procure: I'll review the amendment when it arrives. If vendor delays waiver/amendment, fallback = credit + extend loaner window.

 elaine_ops: One more ask - DOA detection window? We need at least 7 days to claim DOA.

 tom_vendor: DOA window = 14 calendar days from receipt for full credit eligibility. After 14 days, standard RMA terms apply. We'll put this clause in the amendment.

 maya_eng: Action items: 1) Tom send PO amendment + waiver + AWB details (tom_vendor). 2) Ops prepare serial CSV + depot manifest (elaine_ops). 3) Procure sign amendment & confirm payment terms (raj_procure). I'll monitor INF-VEND-4521.

 elaine_ops: Will prep manifest and QC checklist, will coordinate pickup windows.

 raj_procure: Heads up - I'll ping finance re: invoice timing once amendment lands.

 tom_vendor: Amendment PDF sent (email + portal). Please confirm receipt and sign-off.

 maya_eng: Received. tagging INF-VEND-4521 watchers. Thanks team.
